info.title: ArchiVerif API
info.description: Québec construction-compliance monitoring: RBQ contractor-licence verification plus RENA (AMP) ineligibility status, with a company watchlist keyed on NEQ. Sources: Régie du bâtiment du Québec (CC BY 4.0) and Autorité des marchés publics (AMP).

get.summary: Verify an RBQ contractor licence by ID
get.description: Returns the full contractor profile for a given RBQ licence ID, plus computed status fields (is_active_today, suspended_since) that hide the underlying ETL audit-trail complexity. Cached in Redis for 1 hour.

get.summary: Unified RBQ + RENA + REA + OQLF status for a company (by NEQ)
get.description: Returns the company's RBQ licence summary + per-licence detail, RENA ineligibility status, REA public-contract authorization, OQLF francisation status, deferred cnesst/ctq/bsp placeholders, and (when authenticated via X-Client-Key) the client's ARQ status and documents for that NEQ. The RBQ/RENA/REA/OQLF blocks are cached in Redis; ARQ and documents are fetched live (client-specific, not cached). A person-linked RENA entry links out to the official AMP page; no natural-person name is returned.

get.summary: Unified company status by internal company_id
get.description: Same unified RBQ + RENA + REA + OQLF (+ client ARQ/documents when authenticated by X-Client-Key) status as GET /v1/verify/company/{neq}, but addressed by the internal company_id (documents-first pivot). For a registry-less company (no NEQ) the licence blocks are empty and neq is null — the identity still resolves (200, not 404). Requires X-Client-Key and the company on the caller's watchlist: 404 when the company_id is unknown, watched by someone else, or the caller is proxy-authenticated (use the by-NEQ route for public registry data).

get.summary: Contractors whose licence was suspended in the most recent ETL run
get.description: Returns the list of contractors whose licence transitioned out of 'Active' status (including dropping from the registry entirely) during the most recent successful ETL run. Robust against late or delayed runs — the result reflects 'last batch ingested', not a calendar-day window.

get.summary: Search contractors by company name (trigram, accent-insensitive)
get.description: Trigram + accent-insensitive search over contractor company names. Min query length 2 characters. Returns top matches ranked by similarity. NOTE: result rows have `suspended_since=null` unconditionally — round-trip to /v1/verify/{licence_id} for the suspension date.

get.summary: Search the company directory by name (jurisdiction-aware)
get.description: Returns directory candidates ({name, city, local_id}) for the query, via the adapter for the given jurisdiction (default QC). For Quebec the source is the RBQ contractor directory (CC BY 4.0), deduped to one candidate per company (NEQ). An unsupported jurisdiction returns supported=false and no candidates — that market is documents-only; add the company by name via POST /v1/watchlist. Min query length 2.

get.summary: Active document-type catalog
get.description: Returns the active document types (code, bilingual label/short/validity hint, flags, optional verify info), ordered. Includes the reserved catch-all row code='other'. Optional jurisdiction filter returns that jurisdiction's types plus global (jurisdiction-null) ones such as 'other'.

parameters.name: jurisdiction

schema.description: Optional jurisdiction code (e.g. QC); returns it + global types
schema.title: Jurisdiction

parameters.description: Optional jurisdiction code (e.g. QC); returns it + global types

post.summary: Add a NEQ to the caller's watchlist
post.description: Adds a 10-digit NEQ to the authenticated client's watchlist. Returns 409 if the NEQ is already present. Returns 422 if the NEQ is not exactly 10 digits.

get.summary: List the caller's watched NEQs (optionally with full status)
get.description: Returns NEQs on the authenticated client's watchlist, newest first. With include=status, each entry additionally carries the full company status block (same shape as GET /v1/verify/company/{neq}, incl. the client's ARQ enrichment) and the Tier-2 documents list (same shape as GET /v1/documents/{neq}) — one call instead of 1 + 2N dashboard round trips. A watched NEQ unknown to both RBQ and RENA yields status: null, never a per-row 404. Pagination applies in both modes.

parameters.name: include

schema.description: Set to 'status' for the bulk status+documents payload
schema.title: Include

parameters.description: Set to 'status' for the bulk status+documents payload

schema.title: Response List Watchlist V1 Watchlist Get

delete.summary: Remove a NEQ from the caller's watchlist
delete.description: Deletes the given NEQ from the authenticated client's watchlist. Returns 404 if not found.

delete.summary: Remove a company from the caller's watchlist by company_id
delete.description: Deletes the watchlist row for the given internal company_id from the authenticated client's watchlist. Works for registry-less companies (no NEQ) and NEQ-backed rows alike. Returns 404 if not found.

post.description: Creates a project with a server-generated PROJECT-<id> code. A legacy name field is accepted but discarded. Returns 403 if the client's tier cap is reached. Projects organize the watchlist and never affect billing.

get.summary: List the caller's projects
get.description: Returns the authenticated client's projects, newest first, each with its company_count (number of companies grouped in the project).

get.summary: Get one project's metadata
get.description: Returns the project if it belongs to the caller; 404 otherwise.

patch.description: Updates status ('active' | 'archived'). Project codes are server-generated; a rename returns 422. An empty patch returns 422 and a foreign id returns 404.

delete.description: Deletes the project and its memberships (project_companies cascade). Watchlist entries are NEVER deleted — companies keep being monitored. 404 if not owned.

post.description: Adds one NEQ ({neq}) or a batch ({neqs: [...]}) to the project. A NEQ not yet on the caller's watchlist is added to it first — that new entry is subject to the tier company-count limit (403 when it would exceed it, nothing written); a NEQ already on the watchlist joins the project with no billing change. Idempotent: re-adding an existing membership is a no-op 200, never a duplicate. Newly-watched NEQs get the same instant RENA + REA lookups as POST /v1/watchlist.

get.summary: List a project's companies with unified status
get.description: Returns every company in the project with the unified RBQ + RENA + REA + OQLF status from the existing resolver (same shape as GET /v1/verify/company/{neq}; a NEQ unknown to both RBQ and RENA yields status: null, never a per-row 404), plus source attribution. The payload is cached in Redis and invalidated on membership changes and nightly registry deltas touching a member.

delete.summary: Remove a company from a project
delete.description: Deletes the membership row only. The watchlist entry is untouched (the company may be in other projects or watched standalone) — monitoring and billing are unaffected. 404 when the project is not the caller's or the company is not in it.

post.description: Creates a client record and issues a one-time API key. The raw key is returned ONCE in this response; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Requires X-Admin-Secret header matching ADMIN_PROVISION_SECRET. Intended for server-to-server calls from the Stripe/Firebase webhook.
Return a client's activation state and billing tier without changing either.

patch.description: Idempotently set a client's activation state without changing its tier.

post.summary: Recoverably provision a first-party API client
post.description: Creates a client from a caller-persisted base64url candidate, or recognizes an exact committed retry bound to the caller-supplied SHA-256 Firebase UID hash. PostgreSQL stores only hashes; raw Firebase UIDs are rejected. Server-to-server only; requires X-Admin-Secret.

post.summary: Recoverably rotate a first-party API client key
post.description: Atomically replaces an active API-tier client's current key hash with a caller-persisted replacement hash. Exact committed retries return the original timestamp without another audit row. The response contains no key. Server-to-server only; requires X-Admin-Secret.

patch.description: Updates the tier of the client identified by its raw API key (hashed for lookup, never stored or logged). Intended for server-to-server calls from the first-party Stripe webhook so the billing tier enforced here never drifts from the subscription. Recomputes the watchlist_overage flag; no watchlist rows are ever deleted. Requires X-Admin-Secret.

get.summary: Companies newly added to RENA in the latest run
get.description: Watched NEQs that newly appeared on the RENA register during the most recent successful RENA ingestion run. Corporate fields only; person-linked entries link out to the official AMP page and carry no source-derived details.

get.summary: Watched NEQs newly removed from REA in the latest run
get.description: Watched NEQs that disappeared from the REA (Registre des entreprises autorisées) during the most recent successful REA run — i.e. they may have lost authorization to bid on or hold public contracts. Corporate fields only. Source: Autorité des marchés publics (REA).

get.summary: OQLF francisation status changes in the latest run
get.description: Watched NEQs whose OQLF francisation status changed during the most recent successful OQLF run, across both lists (non-conformes blacklist and certifiées whitelist). Source: Office québécois de la langue française.

post.summary: Upload an ARQ PDF for a watched NEQ
post.description: Parses the uploaded ARQ PDF in memory, stores only structured corporate fields and a filesystem path reference. No raw PDF bytes enter the database. The NEQ must be on the client's watchlist. Content-Type must be application/pdf; max 5 MB.

get.summary: Get current ARQ status for a watched NEQ
get.description: Returns the most-recent active ARQ record for the authenticated client's NEQ. status: 'valid' (>0 days remaining), 'expired' (<=0 days), or 'missing' (no record on file). Cached in Redis for 1 hour.

delete.summary: Soft-delete the ARQ record for a watched NEQ
delete.description: Sets deleted_at = NOW() on ALL the caller's active ARQ records for this NEQ. The files are retained for the cleanup retention window (DOC_CLEANUP_RETENTION_DAYS — the dispute window) and removed by the nightly cleanup job. Returns 404 if no active record exists.

get.summary: Download the stored ARQ PDF for a watched NEQ
get.description: Returns the most-recent active ARQ record's PDF as an application/pdf attachment ({neq}-arq.pdf). The NEQ must be on the caller's watchlist (403 otherwise). 404 if no active ARQ record exists or its file is missing from storage.

post.summary: Request document(s) from a subcontractor via a magic link
post.description: Generates an upload link covering one or more document types (doc_types list, or the legacy single doc_type) and emails it to the subcontractor. The NEQ must be on the caller's watchlist. The subcontractor email is used once to send the request and is never stored. If cnesst_attestation is requested, end_date is required (client-specified attestation expiry). expires_in_hours (1–2160) overrides the default 7-day lifetime. The link stays valid until every requested type is uploaded successfully or it expires. Types already on file as a valid (>30 days to expiry) copy are filled immediately (listed in `reused`) and excluded from the sub request — no link/email at all if everything is on file; force=true skips this reuse.

get.summary: Valid on-file copies the caller could reuse for a NEQ
get.description: Read-only: for the watched NEQ, returns the document types for which a valid (>30 days to expiry) copy exists in the caller's account, so the UI can offer 'use the copy on file' instead of emailing the subcontractor again. Corporate-only (doc type + issued/expiry dates). The frontend feeds the caller's choice back as `reuse_doc_types` on POST /v1/magic-link/{neq}. 404 when the NEQ is not on the caller's watchlist.

post.summary: Request an opaque 'other' document from a subcontractor by company_id
post.description: Request a catch-all 'other' document for a company addressed by its internal company_id — including a REGISTRY-LESS company with no NEQ (documents-first pivot). Always an 'other' request: the backend assigns an opaque document id; the upload is stored as-is (no parsing) and never shared cross-client. The company must be on the caller's watchlist (404 otherwise). For typed Quebec documents on an NEQ company, use POST /v1/magic-link/{neq}.

get.summary: Fetch upload-token metadata (no auth)
get.description: Read-only: the upload page calls this to render the correct form(s). Returns the requested doc types, which have been uploaded so far, the token's expiry, and whether the link is completed (already_used). Does NOT consume the token. 404 for an unknown token.

post.summary: Upload a document via a magic-link token (no auth)
post.description: Public endpoint: the token in the path IS the authorization. The PDF is parsed in memory; its NEQ must match the requested company. A failed parse does NOT consume the token — the subcontractor can retry until expiry. For links covering several document types, the doc_type form field names the type being uploaded; each requested type is accepted exactly once; the link completes (and stops accepting uploads) once every requested type has been saved. Max 5 MB, application/pdf only. Rejections return a structured 422 detail: {code: NEQ_MISMATCH, found, expected} | {code: UNREADABLE_PDF} | {code: WRONG_DOC_TYPE, expected}.

The client uploads a subcontractor document it already holds, instead of requesting it via a magic link. Same in-memory parsing and validation as the magic-link upload, with the same structured 422 rejections: {code: NEQ_MISMATCH, found, expected} | {code: UNREADABLE_PDF} | {code: WRONG_DOC_TYPE, expected, found}. Max 5 MB, application/pdf only. The stored copy is provenance-marked client_upload; all reuse is tenant-local. 404 when the NEQ is not on the caller's watchlist; 403 when the pair is suspended over the tier limit.

get.summary: List the caller's Tier-2 document statuses for a NEQ
get.description: Returns every active uploaded document for the authenticated client + NEQ, with computed expiry status (valid / expiring / expired).

get.summary: List the caller's documents for a company by internal company_id
get.description: Same as GET /v1/documents/{neq} but addressed by the internal company_id (documents-first pivot). Resolves the company's NEQ and returns the caller's active documents for it (empty for a registry-less company until its own documents land). 404 when the company_id is unknown or not on the caller's watchlist. Only the caller's own documents are returned (bounded by client_id).

get.summary: Download the stored PDF for an uploaded Tier-2 document
get.description: Returns the caller's active document for this NEQ + doc_type as an application/pdf attachment. The NEQ must be on the caller's watchlist (403 otherwise). 404 if no active document exists or its file is missing from storage, 422 for an unknown doc_type.

parameters.name: label

schema.description: Backend-issued OTHER-… compatibility code; required for 'other'
schema.title: Label

parameters.description: Backend-issued OTHER-… compatibility code; required for 'other'

delete.description: Sets deleted_at = NOW() on the active document for this NEQ + doc_type. The file is retained for the cleanup retention window (dispute window) and removed by the nightly cleanup job. Returns 404 if no active document exists, 422 for an unknown doc_type.

parameters.name: label

schema.description: Backend-issued OTHER-… compatibility code; required for 'other'
schema.title: Label

parameters.description: Backend-issued OTHER-… compatibility code; required for 'other'

get.summary: Download a stored 'other' PDF by internal company_id
get.description: Same as GET /v1/documents/{neq}/other/file but addressed by the internal company_id, so a REGISTRY-LESS company's 'other' documents are reachable (they have no NEQ to address them by). `label` names the document. 404 when the company_id is unknown or not on the caller's watchlist, or when no active document matches; 422 for a blank label.

delete.summary: Soft-delete an 'other' document by internal company_id
delete.description: Same as DELETE /v1/documents/{neq}/other but addressed by the internal company_id, so a REGISTRY-LESS company's 'other' documents can be removed. `label` names the document. Sets deleted_at = NOW(); the file is retained for the cleanup retention window. 404 when the company_id is unknown or not on the caller's watchlist, or when no active document matches; 422 for a blank label.

get.summary: Download a stored document by opaque document_id
get.description: Returns one caller-owned active document by company_id + document_id. The company must be on the caller's watchlist. Unknown, foreign, deleted, and missing-file cases use a uniform 404.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a stored document by opaque document_id
delete.description: Soft-deletes one caller-owned active document by company_id + document_id. Unknown, foreign, and already-deleted rows use a uniform 404.

post.summary: Send a test email to the authenticated client's own address
post.description: Sends one test alert email to the email on file for the authenticated client (resolved server-side from the client record — never from the request body), in the client's language. Returns the address it was sent to. 404 if the client has no email on file; 503 if email delivery is unavailable.

get.summary: Read the caller's notification opt-in flags + email language
get.description: Returns the client's email opt-in flags (default true when never set) and email language ('fr' default).

put.summary: Upsert the caller's notification opt-in flags + email language
put.description: Partial update: only provided (non-null) fields change; omitted fields keep their current value. ``language`` ('fr' | 'en') sets the language every client-facing email renders in — the web app pushes the user's page language here. Returns the full, updated preference set.

get.summary: Current client's API key info (never the full key)
get.description: Returns metadata about the authenticated client's API key: an 8-character preview (derived from the presented header — only the SHA-256 hash is stored), the key's effective creation time, last use, plan, and the plan's per-minute rate limit. Pro and Entreprise plans only.

post.summary: Rotate the client's API key (old key invalidated immediately)
post.description: Generates a fresh API key for the authenticated client and returns it ONCE — only its SHA-256 hash is stored, and the previous key stops working the moment this call commits. The rotation is recorded in the notification log. Pro and Entreprise plans only.

ARQStatusDetail.title: ARQStatusDetail
ARQStatusDetail.description:
ARQ (Attestation de Revenu Québec) status for a watched NEQ.

status: 'valid' (days_remaining >= 0 — an ARQ expiring today still counts),
        'expired' (strictly past expiry), or 'missing' (no ARQ record on
        file for this client+NEQ). Dates are compared on a Montreal-local
        calendar. expires_at/days_remaining are None when status == 'missing'.

ARQUploadResponse.title: ARQUploadResponse
ARQUploadResponse.description: Returned by POST /v1/arq/{neq} on a successful upload.

AdminKeyRotationResponse.title: AdminKeyRotationResponse
AdminKeyRotationResponse.description: Key-free result for a recoverable first-party rotation.

doc_type.title: Doc Type
doc_type.description: One of: arq, ccq_conformite, cnesst_attestation, assurance_rc, assurance_transport, or 'other'

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: CNESST end date, or the (optional) expiry for an 'other' document

label.title: Label
label.description: Deprecated and discarded; the backend assigns an opaque code

doc_type.title: Doc Type
doc_type.description: Requested document type this file is for (required when the link covers several types)

ClientCreateRequest.title: ClientCreateRequest
ClientCreateRequest.description:
Request body for POST /v1/clients. Validates that a non-empty email is
provided; ``tier`` is optional (subscription tier known at checkout-time
provisioning — defaults to 'free' when omitted).

``stripe_customer_id`` is optional and links the Stripe customer at
provisioning so the Stripe webhook can resolve the client by
``stripe_customer_id`` on a subscription that carries no
``metadata.client_id`` — the PAD/ACSS case, where the subscription is created
server-side after the hosted setup flow rather than by Checkout.

ClientCreateResponse.title: ClientCreateResponse
ClientCreateResponse.description:
Client creation result; PostgreSQL retains only the API-key hash.

The legacy route returns its generated key once. The recoverable admin route
can echo the candidate supplied by that authenticated caller on an exact retry.

ClientTierUpdateRequest.title: ClientTierUpdateRequest
ClientTierUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for PATCH /v1/clients/tier (admin tier sync).

``client_key`` is the client's raw API key — the only identifier the
first-party frontend holds (email is not unique). It is hashed for lookup
and never stored or logged.

ClientTierUpdateResponse.title: ClientTierUpdateResponse
ClientTierUpdateResponse.description: Result of an admin tier sync: the updated tier + recomputed overage flag.

ClientUploadResponse.title: ClientUploadResponse
ClientUploadResponse.description:
Returned by POST /v1/documents/{neq}/upload — the client uploaded a
document it already holds itself, with no magic link involved. For the catch-all
'other' type, ``label`` is a UUID-derived compatibility code and ``expires_at``
may be null (no expiry).

CompanyCandidate.title: CompanyCandidate
CompanyCandidate.description:
One directory/typeahead hit for the company search bar.

``company_id`` is the internal identity — populated when a company row already
exists for this candidate (it is created/resolved when the company is added via
POST /v1/watchlist), else null. ``neq`` is the QC registry key (null for a
jurisdiction whose registry key is not an NEQ). ``city`` is best-effort.

CompanyLicence.title: CompanyLicence
CompanyLicence.description: One RBQ licence held under the company's NEQ (per-licence detail, D6).

CompanyMagicLinkRequest.title: CompanyMagicLinkRequest
CompanyMagicLinkRequest.description:
Body for POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/magic-link — request a catch-all
'other' document from a subcontractor for a company addressed by its
internal ``company_id``. Works for a **registry-less** company (no NEQ). It is
always an 'other' request. Legacy ``label`` input is discarded; ``end_date`` is
the optional expiry of the requested document.

source.title: Source
source.default: Régie du bâtiment du Québec (CC BY 4.0)

CompanySearchResponse.title: CompanySearchResponse
CompanySearchResponse.description:
Response for GET /v1/companies/search.

``supported`` is False when the requested jurisdiction has no adapter — the
market is documents-only (search returns no candidates, but a company can still
be added by name). ``source`` attributes the QC directory (RBQ CC BY 4.0).

CompanyStatusResponse.title: CompanyStatusResponse
CompanyStatusResponse.description:
Unified RBQ + RENA + REA + OQLF + ARQ status for one company (by NEQ).

The rbq / rena / rena_detail / arq / source fields are the original live
contract and are unchanged. The rea / oqlf / cnesst / ctq / bsp / documents /
source_attribution fields are additive (all defaulted so older cached payloads
self-validate). Law 25: no natural-person name ever appears in any block.

ContractorSummary.title: ContractorSummary
ContractorSummary.description: Trimmed row shape for list endpoints (search + suspensions).

DocumentEntry.title: DocumentEntry
DocumentEntry.description:
One Tier-2 document's status for GET /v1/documents/{neq}.

``label`` is the UUID-derived compatibility code for a catch-all 'other' document
(null for typed docs). ``expires_at`` may be null for an expiry-less document.

DocumentSummary.title: DocumentSummary
DocumentSummary.description:
One uploaded Tier-2 document's expiry status for the unified response.

``status``: 'valid' (>30 days), 'expiring' (0 < days <= 30), 'expired'
(<= 0 days), or 'missing' (no document on file). Client-specific — never cached.

DocumentTypeEntry.title: DocumentTypeEntry
DocumentTypeEntry.description:
One row of the document-type catalog.

Backend owns ``label_*``/``short_*`` so a new type renders without a frontend
deploy (the frontend prefers its own i18n for codes it knows, falls back to
these). ``parsed`` = the backend extracts NEQ/expiry (vs. store-as-is);
``requestable`` = offerable via magic link; ``reuse_eligible`` = may fill a
request from the same client's valid on-file copy.
The reserved catch-all ``code='other'`` is parsed=false, reuse_eligible=false,
requestable=true (backend-owned opaque identity, optional expiry).

DocumentTypesResponse.title: DocumentTypesResponse
DocumentTypesResponse.description: Response for GET /v1/document-types — the active catalog, ordered.

DocumentsResponse.title: DocumentsResponse
DocumentsResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/documents/{neq} (and /v1/companies/{id}/documents).
Client's own data — no attribution. ``neq`` is null for a registry-less company
(addressed by ``company_id``); ``company_id`` is populated on the by-id route.

FirebaseUserCreatedEventRequest.title: FirebaseUserCreatedEventRequest
FirebaseUserCreatedEventRequest.description: Validated Firebase signup event without storing a raw UID in receipts.

KeyInfoResponse.title: KeyInfoResponse
KeyInfoResponse.description:
Key metadata for the authenticated client — NEVER the full key.

``key_preview`` is the first 8 characters of the key presented on this very
request (the server stores only the SHA-256 hash, so it cannot reveal more).
``created_at`` is the key's effective creation time: the last rotation, or
the client's provisioning time if never rotated.

KeyRotateResponse.title: KeyRotateResponse
KeyRotateResponse.description:
Returned ONCE by POST /v1/keys/rotate — the only moment the new key
exists in plaintext. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.

source.title: Source
source.default: Régie du bâtiment du Québec (CC BY 4.0)

ListEnvelope.title: ListEnvelope
ListEnvelope.description:
Generic list response wrapper. Attribution lives once at the top.

`count` is `len(results)` (page count), not a database total — see Phase 2
spec decision #15.

MagicLinkCreateRequest.title: MagicLinkCreateRequest
MagicLinkCreateRequest.description:
Body for POST /v1/magic-link/{neq} — request document(s) from a subcontractor.

Accepts either the legacy single ``doc_type`` or a ``doc_types`` list (exactly one
of the two); both normalize into ``doc_types`` (deduped, validated against
DOC_TYPES) with ``doc_type`` mirroring the first item. ``expires_in_hours``
optionally overrides the default TTL (MAGIC_LINK_TTL_DAYS, 7 days).

MagicLinkCreateResponse.title: MagicLinkCreateResponse
MagicLinkCreateResponse.description:
Returned by POST /v1/magic-link/{neq}. ``doc_types`` lists what the sub is
being asked for; ``reused`` lists requested types filled from a valid copy
already in the caller's account. When every requested type was reused,
no link exists: ``upload_url``/``expires_at``/``doc_type`` are null,
``doc_types`` is empty and ``email_sent`` is false. ``doc_type`` mirrors
``doc_types[0]`` for legacy single-doc consumers. ``neq`` is null for a
registry-less company's link (created via /v1/companies/{company_id}/magic-link).

NotificationPrefs.title: NotificationPrefs
NotificationPrefs.description:
A client's email notification opt-in flags + email language.

Missing prefs row → all flags True. ``language`` lives on the clients row
('fr' | 'en', default 'fr' — Quebec): every client-facing email renders in it.

NotificationPrefsUpdate.title: NotificationPrefsUpdate
NotificationPrefsUpdate.description:
Partial update for PUT /v1/notifications/prefs.

Each field is optional; only provided (non-null) fields are changed, so the
web app can push a single toggle or the full set. An empty body is a no-op
that returns the current prefs. ``language`` must be 'fr' or 'en' — the web
app pushes the user's page language here.

OqlfStatus.title: OqlfStatus
OqlfStatus.description:
OQLF francisation status for a NEQ.

``conformes_status``: 'listed' = the company name matches the OQLF *non-conformes*
blacklist (an alert condition); 'not_listed' otherwise. ``certifiees_status``:
'certified' = on the certified whitelist, 'not_certified' = watched but absent,
'not_monitored' = NEQ not watched. ``last_checked`` is the certifiées row's
detected_at when certified, else null.

OqlfTodayEntry.title: OqlfTodayEntry
OqlfTodayEntry.description:
An OQLF status change for a watched NEQ in the latest run.

``list_name``: 'non_conformes' (blacklist) or 'certifiees' (whitelist).
``change_type``: 'ADDED' or 'REMOVED'. For non_conformes, ADDED is the alert
(appeared on the blacklist); for certifiees, REMOVED is the alert (lost
certification). ``oqlf_url`` links to the relevant official list.

source.title: Source
source.default: Office québécois de la langue française

OqlfTodayResponse.title: OqlfTodayResponse
OqlfTodayResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/oqlf/today.

'today' = the most recent successful OQLF etl_runs row, not a calendar day.
`count` is the page count (length of `results`), not a database total.

ProjectCompaniesAddRequest.title: ProjectCompaniesAddRequest
ProjectCompaniesAddRequest.description:
Request body for POST /v1/projects/{project_id}/companies.

Accepts a single ``neq``, a batch ``neqs``, or both; ``all_neqs()`` merges
them into one deduped, order-preserving list. Every NEQ must be exactly 10
digits; at least one is required.

ProjectCompaniesAddResponse.title: ProjectCompaniesAddResponse
ProjectCompaniesAddResponse.description:
Result of a membership add. ``watchlist_created`` lists the NEQs that were
genuinely new to the client's watchlist (the only ones that move the billing
count); ``already_present`` were already members of this project (no-op).

ProjectCompaniesResponse.title: ProjectCompaniesResponse
ProjectCompaniesResponse.description:
Project-scoped status payload for GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/companies.

Carries the same source attribution as the unified company endpoint
(RBQ CC BY 4.0, AMP for RENA/REA, OQLF). Cacheable: holds no
client-specific data; ownership is enforced before the cache is read.

ProjectCompanyEntry.title: ProjectCompanyEntry
ProjectCompanyEntry.description:
One company in a project, with its unified multi-registry status.

``status`` is exactly the GET /v1/verify/company/{neq} payload (NEQ-agnostic,
no client-specific blocks) — None when the NEQ is unknown to both RBQ and
RENA (never a per-row 404).

ProjectCreateRequest.title: ProjectCreateRequest
ProjectCreateRequest.description: Create a project whose response name is the server-owned ``PROJECT-<id>``.

ProjectEntry.title: ProjectEntry
ProjectEntry.description:
One project as returned by the API. ``company_count`` is the number of
project_companies rows — an organizational count, never a billing input.

ProjectListResponse.title: ProjectListResponse
ProjectListResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/projects. No `source` field: projects are the
client's own internal data, not sourced from a public register.

ProjectPatchRequest.title: ProjectPatchRequest
ProjectPatchRequest.description:
Request body for PATCH /v1/projects/{project_id}: archive state only.

The deprecated name field is discarded and the route rejects rename intent.

ReaStatus.title: ReaStatus
ReaStatus.description:
REA (AMP) public-contract authorization status for a NEQ.

``status``: 'authorized' (on the register), 'not_authorized' (watched but
absent — checked, not listed), or 'not_monitored' (NEQ not on any watchlist,
so REA never looked it up). ``last_checked`` is the row's detected_at, or null.

ReaTodayEntry.title: ReaTodayEntry
ReaTodayEntry.description:
A watched NEQ newly REMOVED from REA in the latest run — i.e. it lost its
authorization to hold/bid public contracts. Corporate fields only.

REA has no per-NEQ deep link, so ``rea_url`` points at the public register's
search page. ``company_name`` (when present) is the RBQ legal name (CC BY 4.0).

ReaTodayResponse.title: ReaTodayResponse
ReaTodayResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/rea/today.

'today' = the most recent successful REA etl_runs row, not a calendar day.
`count` is the page count (length of `results`), not a database total.

RecoverableClientProvisionRequest.title: RecoverableClientProvisionRequest
RecoverableClientProvisionRequest.description:
First-party provisioning with a caller-persisted recovery candidate.

The candidate is deliberately not normalized: leading/trailing whitespace,
padding, and non-base64url characters are rejected instead of changed.

RecoverableClientProvisionResponse.title: RecoverableClientProvisionResponse
RecoverableClientProvisionResponse.description: First-party provisioning result with explicit create/replay identity.

RegistryNotMonitored.title: RegistryNotMonitored
RegistryNotMonitored.description:
Status block for a deferred registry (CNESST / CTQ / BSP).

These sources are reCAPTCHA-gated and not yet ingested; the block always
reports 'not_monitored' until official API access is available.

RenaDetail.title: RenaDetail
RenaDetail.description: RENA detail; linked rows retain only public link context and the NEQ outside it.

RenaTodayEntry.title: RenaTodayEntry
RenaTodayEntry.description: A newly added RENA row; linked rows contain no source-derived details.

RenaTodayResponse.title: RenaTodayResponse
RenaTodayResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/rena/today.

'today' = the most recent successful RENA etl_runs row, not a calendar day.
`count` is the page count (length of `results`), not a database total.

ReusableDocumentsResponse.title: ReusableDocumentsResponse
ReusableDocumentsResponse.description:
Returned by GET /v1/magic-link/{neq}/reusable — the valid copies already
on file for this NEQ that the caller could fill INSTEAD of requesting them
from the subcontractor. Every row is owned by the caller, active, and more
than 30 days from expiry. Corporate-only (doc type + dates).

ReusedDocument.title: ReusedDocument
ReusedDocument.description: A requested type filled from the caller's valid on-file copy.

TestEmailResponse.title: TestEmailResponse
TestEmailResponse.description: Returned by POST /v1/notifications/test on a successful send.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Returned by POST /v1/upload/{token} on a successful upload. ``completed``
is true once every requested doc type has been uploaded (the token is spent);
``pending_doc_types`` lists what the link still expects. For the catch-all 'other'
type, ``label`` is a UUID-derived compatibility code and ``expires_at`` may be null.
``neq`` is null for a registry-less company's link.

UploadTokenInfo.title: UploadTokenInfo
UploadTokenInfo.description:
Returned by GET /v1/upload/{token} so the upload page can render the right form.

Corporate-only: NEQ + doc types + token state. ``already_used`` is true once the
link is completed (every requested type uploaded); ``expires_at`` lets the page
show an expired link. ``doc_type`` mirrors the first *pending* type (or the first
requested once complete) for the legacy single-doc page.

source.title: Source
source.default: Régie du bâtiment du Québec (CC BY 4.0)

VerifyResponse.title: VerifyResponse
VerifyResponse.description: Scalar response — full contractor profile for GET /v1/verify/{licence_id}.

WatchlistAddRequest.title: WatchlistAddRequest
WatchlistAddRequest.description:
Request body for POST /v1/watchlist. Add a company by EITHER:

  - ``neq`` — a 10-digit Quebec NEQ (registry-backed company), or
  - ``registryless=true`` (+ optional ``jurisdiction``, default ``QC``) — an
    unnamed identity with no supported registry identifier.

A legacy non-null ``company_name`` is accepted only as a compatibility signal for
registry-less intent and is discarded before model construction (Law 25).

WatchlistEntry.title: WatchlistEntry
WatchlistEntry.description:
A single watchlist row as returned by the API.

``neq`` is null for a registry-less company (watched by ``company_id`` only,
documents-first pivot Phase 1 PR-B); a NEQ-backed row carries both.

WatchlistResponse.title: WatchlistResponse
WatchlistResponse.description:
List response for GET /v1/watchlist.

No `source` field: the watchlist is the client's own internal data,
not sourced from RBQ or AMP, so no attribution is required.

WatchlistStatusEntry.title: WatchlistStatusEntry
WatchlistStatusEntry.description:
One watched company with its full status + Tier-2 documents, for the
bulk dashboard payload.

``status`` is exactly the GET /v1/verify/company/{neq} payload (incl. the
client-specific arq enrichment) — None when the NEQ is unknown to both RBQ
and RENA, and always None for a registry-less company (no NEQ to look up).
``documents`` is exactly the GET /v1/documents/{neq} list. ``neq`` is null for
a registry-less company (watched by ``company_id`` only).

WatchlistStatusResponse.title: WatchlistStatusResponse
WatchlistStatusResponse.description:
Bulk response for GET /v1/watchlist?include=status — one entry per
watched company, replacing the dashboard's per-company round trips.
